title: Brand Strategy & Content Plan
body:
# Self-Taught Labs - Brand Strategy & 30-Day Content Plan

## Company Mission
**Self-Taught Labs** is a personal brand studio for a self-taught Senior Developer with 7+ years of experience in Angular/.NET who builds open-source AI tools.

## Strategic Goals (Next 90 Days)

### Goal 1: LinkedIn Growth
- Target: 500+ followers in 90 days
- Strategy: Position as expert Angular/.NET developer who self-taught AI/ML
- Content mix: 60% technical, 30% personal brand, 10% industry commentary

### Goal 2: Open-Source AI Tool v1
- Target: Ship first open-source AI tool
- Tech stack: Angular + .NET + AI integration
- Focus: Solve a real problem for Angular/.NET developers

### Goal 3: Content Production
- Target: 3-4 LinkedIn posts/week
- Format mix: Carousels, single images, short-form video, threads

---

## First Open-Source AI Tool Recommendation

**Recommended: Angular AI Component Generator**
- Uses AI to generate Angular components from descriptions
- Solves real pain point: developers spend hours creating boilerplate
- Leverages existing expertise: Angular + AI = unique positioning
- Differentiation: Most AI code generators focus on React; Angular is underserved

## First LinkedIn Post Recommendation

**Topic:** I self-taught AI after 7 years of Angular/.NET - My journey

**Why this works:**
1. Authentic personal story - differentiates from generic tech content
2. Self-taught angle - resonates with junior devs and career changers
3. Credibility anchor - first post sets the narrative
4. Emotional hook - vulnerability builds connection

**Hook idea:**
After 7 years of Angular and .NET, I decided to self-teach AI. Everyone said I was too late. Here is what happened next...

---

## Execution Roadmap (Weekly Tasks)

### Week 1-2: Foundation
- Set up LinkedIn personal profile optimized for personal brand
- Draft and schedule Week 1-2 content (14 posts)
- Research and validate AI tool idea
- Create GitHub repo for open-source project

### Week 3-4: Build & Launch
- Develop AI Component Generator v1
- Draft and schedule Week 3-4 content (14 posts)
- Prepare launch assets
- Execute launch campaign (Days 24-26)

### Ongoing
- Monitor analytics weekly
- Iterate content strategy based on engagement
- Plan Month 2 content based on learnings
